language.title: Language
language.description: Language for the interface, messages and AI-written text.

skill.title: opencode skill
skill.description: Teaches opencode to work on tasks the same way every time: it writes the plan in PLAN.md, logs every commit in HISTORIAL.md and never pushes, opens a PR or changes JIRA without your confirmation. That way each task's details page shows the phase and the changes.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: A copy of the database is saved every day. The 7 most recent are kept.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.appModelHint: Used by Ask, Draft with AI and the summaries. There the model only returns text; it does not touch files.
